name: Infinite Archives x Air Jordan 17 Retro Low 'Beach'
story_html: The Infinite Archives x Air Jordan 17 Retro Low 'Beach' makes use of a cream-colored leather upper with chrome eyelets and oblong perforations on the side panel. Contrasting black accents make their way to the knit collar and perforated leather eyestay. A prismatic pop of color arrives via the iridescent TPU heel clip. Performance benefits include a polyurethane midsole, wrapped in a translucent TPU chassis and equipped with a top-loaded Zoom Air unit in the forefoot and Air-sole cushioning in the heel
